metadata.case_name: SIT YAU SHING v. YAN YAN MOTORS LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: self-employed construction project manager, working from project to project for different construction or decoration companies.

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to his lower back
source: the symptoms complained of by Mr Sit were consistent with soft tissue injury to his lower back, left elbow and right knee
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to his left elbow; laceration on his left elbow and forearm
source: the symptoms complained of by Mr Sit were consistent with soft tissue injury to his lower back, left elbow and right knee
He felt pain in his back, right knee, left elbow and his chest. He noticed that there was laceration on his left elbow and forearm.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of forearm

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to his right knee
source: the symptoms complained of by Mr Sit were consistent with soft tissue injury to his lower back, left elbow and right knee
the injuries to his elbow and knee were mild
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of other or unspecified parts of knee

manifestations.description: laceration on his left elbow and forearm
lost his balance and fell from his seat onto the aisle
residual pain and impairment in the low back (described by expert as mild)

treatments_received: taken by ambulance to Pok Oi Hospital Accident & Emergency
treatment at Pok Oi Hospital A&E
transferred to Tuen Mun Hospital and admitted
